title: All 12 hx-on:: handlers are dead: app CSP blocks htmx's eval
repro:
1. ARXMCP_BOOTSTRAP_MODE=1 ARXMCP_BIND_PORT=7804 uv run python -m server.main
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/ in a browser with devtools console open
3. Type slug 'INVALID_Slug!!' and click Create
4. Read the console
expected: hx-on:: handlers should run. Every error-surfacing path and every post-success cleanup in the UI is implemented with them (index.html:38-39 comments describe the intended behaviour), so with them dead the UI has NO working error display and NO post-success cleanup anywhere.

title: Server 4xx on create notebook shows nothing at all to the user
repro:
1. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/
2. Slug 'INVALID_Slug!!' -> click Create  (server returns 422)
3. Slug of an EXISTING notebook -> click Create  (server returns 409)
4. Inspect: document.getElementById('create-error').textContent
observed:
POST http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/api/notebooks -> 422 Unprocessable Entity
POST http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/api/notebooks -> 409 Conflict
document.getElementById('create-error').textContent === ""   (empty in both cases)
#notebooks-tbody row count unchanged. No toast, no inline message, no colour change. The button re-enables and the page looks exactly as before the click.
expected: The 422/409 detail should render into #create-error (index.html:39 hx-on::response-error is written to do exactly that). A user who clicks Create and gets nothing cannot tell whether it worked.

title: Backend death is invisible: stale status badge, silent no-op controls
repro:
1. Start server on 7804, open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/<slug>
2. kill -9 $(lsof -tnP -iTCP:7804 -sTCP:LISTEN)
3. Click 'Rename' (or any control) and wait 30s for the 10s status-badge poll to fail
observed:
Console: htmx:sendError / net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (repeating every 2s and 10s).
DOM probe:
  statusBadge = "WARN | awaiting first ingest ..."  (STALE pre-kill value, class still status-badge--ops-warn)
  errorBlocksNonEmpty = []
  anyOfflineBanner = false
  display name unchanged - the Rename silently did nothing
The page looks completely healthy while the backend is gone; every click is a silent no-op.
expected: A desktop app whose daemon has died must say so. Note that even a working hx-on::response-error would not help here: htmx fires htmx:sendError (not htmx:responseError) for connection failures, and nothing listens for it. The status badge polls /ui/status-badge every 10s (base.html:133) and should fall back to a 'down' state when the poll fails.

title: After a successful create the empty-state row stays and the count is stale
repro:
1. Fresh data dir (ARXMCP_DATA_DIR=/tmp/scratch) so the notebook list is empty
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/ -> shows 'Existing notebooks (0)' + 'No notebooks yet. Create one above.'
3. Create a notebook with a valid slug
observed:
201 Created, the new <tr> is appended - but:
  emptyRowStillThere: true   (<tr id="notebooks-empty">No notebooks yet. Create one above.</tr> still rendered)
  <h2> still reads 'Existing notebooks (0)'
Result: the table simultaneously says 'No notebooks yet' and lists a notebook, under a heading that counts zero.
expected: index.html:38 hx-on::after-request is written to remove #notebooks-empty on success; it never runs (CHAOS-FE-01). The heading count is server-rendered and has no OOB swap, so it is stale until a manual reload.

title: Create form is never reset; a second click silently 409s
repro:
1. Create a notebook successfully via http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/
2. Observe the form still holds the submitted values
3. Click Create again
observed:
formSlugValueAfter: "chaos-fe-xss"  (this.reset() never ran)
Second click -> POST /ui/api/notebooks -> 409 Conflict, #create-error still "".
The user sees a filled form and a button that does nothing.
expected: index.html:38 calls this.reset() on success; dead under CSP (CHAOS-FE-01).

title: slug pattern attribute is an invalid regex; client-side validation is off
repro:
1. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/
2. Type 'INVALID_Slug!!' into the Slug field
3. Console: document.querySelector('input[name=slug]').checkValidity()
observed:
[error] Pattern attribute value [a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30} is not a valid regular expression: Uncaught SyntaxError: Failed to execute 'checkValidity' on 'HTMLInputElement': Invalid regular expression: /[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}/v: Invalid character class
checkValidity() === true ; validity.patternMismatch === false
The HTML spec compiles pattern with the RegExp 'v' flag, where a bare '-' at the end of a character class is a reserved punctuator; compilation throws and the attribute is ignored entirely.
expected: The pattern should reject bad slugs in the browser. Fix is to escape the hyphen or move it: pattern="[a-z][a-z0-9\\-]{2,30}" / "[a-z][-a-z0-9]{2,30}". Combined with CHAOS-FE-02 the user gets neither client-side nor server-side feedback.

title: View-transition InvalidStateError fires on every htmx swap, forever
repro:
1. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/<slug> (any page - base.html polls /ui/status-badge every 10s)
2. Leave it open 30s and read the console
observed:
[error] Uncaught (in promise) {code: 11, name: InvalidStateError, message: Transition was aborted because of invalid state}
Repeats once per htmx swap. On a notebook detail page the ingest-status fragment polls every 2s and the status badge every 10s, so this error accumulates indefinitely (15+ copies within the first minute of my session).
expected: base.html:72 sets htmx.config.globalViewTransitions = true; overlapping/rapid swaps start a view transition while another is in flight and the promise rejection is never caught. A shipped app should not emit a console error every 2 seconds.

title: Whole page scrolls horizontally on mobile (375px) from the LanceDB path
repro:
1. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/bridgeland-stability at 375x812
2. Console: document.documentElement.scrollWidth + ' vs ' + document.documentElement.clientWidth
observed:
scrollWidth 721 vs clientWidth 375 -> the entire page scrolls sideways. Culprit
/Users/chris.dare/Personal/SourceCode/arXMCP/var/arxmcp/notebooks/bridgeland-stability/lancedb
measures 603px with white-space:normal, overflow-wrap:normal, word-break:normal. The unbreakable path sizes the
column to 603px and every sibling
inherits it. Visually: the path, the 'PDF parse - arxiv notebooks skip this' hint and the papers-table Remove button all run off the right edge.
expected: No page-level horizontal scroll at any viewport width. The metadata <dl> needs overflow-wrap:anywhere / min-width:0 on the value column.

title: Long unbroken token in a topic breaks desktop layout (1280px h-scroll)
repro:
1. Create a notebook whose Topic/keywords contains a 145-char unbroken token, e.g. 'A'*145
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/<slug> at 1280x900
3. Console: document.documentElement.scrollWidth
observed:
scrollWidth 1318 vs clientWidth 1280.
Overflow chain: P.topic-description (overflow-wrap:normal) -> DIV#topic-block -> DETAILS#manage -> MAIN#main -> BODY -> HTML.
The topic textarea allows maxlength=512, so a 512-char token is reachable and would push the page far wider.
expected: User-supplied free text must wrap. p.topic-description needs overflow-wrap:anywhere.

title: 404 / 422 for a notebook URL renders raw JSON, not an HTML page
repro:
Open in a browser: http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/does-not-exist
and              http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/A
expected: These are HTML routes reached by clicking links (/ui/notebooks/{slug}); a stale bookmark or a deleted notebook should land on a styled 404 page with a link back to /ui/. Also note the 422 body leaks the internal slug regex to an end user.

title: Unbounded 2s polling forever on a never-ingested notebook
repro:
1. Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/<slug> for a notebook that has never been ingested
2. Watch the network panel
observed:
GET /ui/api/notebooks/<slug>/ingest/latest -> 200, repeating every 2s with no terminal condition (notebook_detail.html:298 states 'none and running both still poll every 2s'), plus GET /ui/status-badge every 10s from base.html:133 on every page.
My 20-minute session logged the ingest/latest poll dozens of times per network-log page.
expected: A desktop app window left open on a notebook that has no ingest run issues ~43,000 requests/day and re-renders a fragment (and re-triggers CHAOS-FE-07) every 2 seconds. The 'none' state has nothing to poll for and should stop.

title: App root / returns raw JSON 404 instead of redirecting to /ui/
repro: curl -i http://127.0.0.1:7804/   (or open it in a browser)
observed:
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
content-type: application/json
{"detail":"Not Found"}
Browser accessibility tree: generic "{\"detail\":\"Not Found\"}"

title: Absolute host filesystem path (incl. user home) shown in the notebook UI
repro: Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/bridgeland-stability and read the 'LanceDB path' row
observed: /Users/chris.dare/Personal/SourceCode/arXMCP/var/arxmcp/notebooks/bridgeland-stability/lancedb

title: Empty papers table renders a header row under the 'no papers' message
repro: Create a notebook with no papers and open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/<slug>
observed: 'Papers in this notebook (0)' then the italic 'No papers yet. Add one from "Manage this notebook" below.' and BELOW it a bare table header row 'PAPER ID | ADDED | PREVIEW' with no rows.

title: Slug input has pattern but no title, so the browser hint is generic
repro: Inspect input[name=slug] on http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/
observed: pattern="[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,30}", required, minlength=3, maxlength=64, title=null
expected: With no title attribute a pattern mismatch reports the generic 'Please match the requested format.' Moot today because the pattern never compiles (CHAOS-FE-06), but it will surface once that is fixed. Note also maxlength=64 vs a 31-char server rule - the field accepts 33 characters the server will always reject.

title: No hx-push-url anywhere: htmx swaps never change the URL
repro: grep -rc hx-push-url server/frontend/templates/*.html server/routes/ui.py server/routes/notebooks.py
observed:
All files: 0. No HX-Push-Url response header is set anywhere in server/ either.
Consequence: after a Discover run or a create, browser Back leaves the page entirely and Reload discards the swapped-in state (the discover candidate queue is explicitly ephemeral). The URL is never a shareable/bookmarkable representation of what is on screen.
expected: Acceptable for a single-window desktop app, but Back after an htmx interaction is a common reflex and it silently loses work here.

title: UI CSP allows script-src 'unsafe-inline'
repro: curl -sD - -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/ | grep -i content-security-policy
observed: content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
expected: 'unsafe-inline' means any future reflected-HTML defect becomes executable script. Autoescaping currently holds everywhere I tested (CHAOS-FE-18), so this is defence-in-depth, not a live hole. A nonce would let both the base.html inline script and the hx-on:: handlers work without it - and would fix CHAOS-FE-01 at the same time.

title: no-repro: XSS / template injection
repro: 1. Create a notebook with display_name '{{7*7}}' and topic containing {{config}}, RTL override U+202E, emoji, zero-width U+200B, <b> entities 2. View it on /ui/ and /ui/notebooks/ 3. Probe window.__XSS / window.__XSS2 4. GET /ui/notebooks/
observed: window.__XSS === false, window.__XSS2 === false on both pages. Rendered: <img src=x onerror="window.__XSS=1"><script>window.__XSS2=1</script>{{7*7}} {{7*7}} and {{config}} render literally - no SSTI. Malformed slug in the URL -> 422 with content-type application/json + x-content-type-options: nosniff, so the reflected slug is not rendered as HTML. Static verification: ui.py:100-105 builds the Jinja2 env with autoescape=select_autoescape(enabled_extensions=('html','htm','xml'), default_for_string=True); zero occurrences of |safe, Markup( or {% autoescape false %} in the templates; every f-string fragment builder in notebooks.py/ui.py routes values through html.escape().
expected: Recorded as a clean pass. Escaping is consistently applied on both the Jinja2 path and the hand-built fragment path.

title: no-repro: path traversal via /ui/static and via slug
repro: for p in '/ui/static/../../../etc/passwd' '/ui/static/..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd' '/ui/static/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/etc/passwd' '/ui/static/%252e%252e%252fetc%252fpasswd' '/ui/static/....//....//etc/passwd' '/ui/notebooks/../../etc/passwd' '/ui/notebooks/%2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2fetc%2fpasswd'; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} '"$p"'\n' "http://127.0.0.1:7804$p"; done
observed: 404 for every variant (single-encoded, double-encoded, mixed-slash, dot-truncation). Slug traversal is rejected by validate_slug before any Path() is built; StaticFiles uses Starlette's commonpath-after-realpath check.

title: no-repro: asset integrity (all static assets 200, htmx 2.0.10)
repro: for p in app.css tokens.css htmx.min.js json-enc.js favicon.svg; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{size_download} '"$p"'\n' "http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/static/$p"; done
observed:
200 37905 app.css / 200 19451 tokens.css / 200 51439 htmx.min.js / 200 2587 json-enc.js / 200 755 favicon.svg
Browser network log confirms all five load on every page; no 404s, no /favicon.ico noise, no mixed content. htmx reports version 2.0.10 (htmx.min.js:2, matches VENDORED.md). json-enc extension registers (htmx.config readable, hx-ext="json-enc" forms send JSON).
Caveat: I did not have network access to check 2.0.10 against a live advisory feed; the vendored SHA-256 in VENDORED.md is pinned by tests/test_vendored_assets_integrity.py.
expected: Clean pass on loading/integrity. Version-advisory check left to the packaging lane.

title: no-repro: accessibility basics (labels, alt, headings, focus, landmarks)
repro: Open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/notebooks/<slug>, run the probe in evidence/frontend/a11y-probe.txt, then Tab through the page
observed:
unlabelled inputs: [] (every input/select/textarea has an associated <label>)
images: 0, so no missing alt
headings: H1 'arXMCP notebooks' then H2s only - no skipped levels
landmarks: HEADER, MAIN, NAV, FOOTER
skip-link is first in tab order; Tab x3 lands on '<- All notebooks' with :focus-visible true and outline 'solid 2px oklch(0.47863 0.115 250)'
Every error block carries aria-live/role=status.

title: no-repro: light/dark theming and desktop/tablet layout
repro: resize to 1280x800 / 768x1024 / 375x812 and toggle colorScheme light|dark on /ui/ and /ui/notebooks/<slug>
observed: tokens.css drives both schemes; light and dark both render correctly on the index and detail pages including the empty first-run state, the status badge and the destructive-button styling. No unstyled/invisible text found in either scheme. The only layout defects found were the horizontal-overflow ones filed as CHAOS-FE-08 and CHAOS-FE-09 (both present in light and dark alike).
expected: Clean pass on theming.

title: First-run experience in bootstrap mode is reasonable but the badge is alarming
repro: ARXMCP_DATA_DIR=<empty dir> ARXMCP_BOOTSTRAP_MODE=1 ARXMCP_BIND_PORT=7804 uv run python -m server.main; open http://127.0.0.1:7804/ui/
observed:
Server was serving /ui/ within 2 seconds (no BGE-M3 stall in bootstrap mode). The page shows the Create-notebook form, 'Existing notebooks (0)' and 'No notebooks yet. Create one above.' - no spinner-forever, no raw error.
The footer badge reads 'WARN | awaiting first ingest' / 'status non-pass - see docs/install.md troubleshooting' in amber.
expected: The empty state itself is fine. But on a brand-new install the very first thing a user sees is an amber WARN telling them the status is 'non-pass' and pointing at a repo file path (docs/install.md) that a desktop-app user has no way to open. 'Awaiting first ingest' is the expected state on day one, not a warning.
